import sys, random, json, os, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_pipeline as sp

rng = random.Random(99)
def run(lines, env=None):
    e = dict(os.environ)
    if env: e.update(env)
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=''.join(l+'\n' for l in lines),
                       text=True, capture_output=True, env=e, timeout=600)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:3000]
    return p.stdout.split('\n')[:-1], dt, p.stderr

# worst case compile: 2048 prefixes
for n, S, ms in [(2048,16,32),(2048,4,32),(2048,8,32),(1024,16,16),(2048,16,8)]:
    fib = gen_fib(rng, n, 'long')
    caps=[10**9]*S
    req={'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':sp.canon_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
         'capacities':caps,'max_stride':ms}
    line=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))
    out,dt,err = run([line])
    obj=json.loads(out[0])
    print('compile n=%d S=%d ms=%d -> %s in %.2fs (out %d bytes) %s' % (n,S,ms,obj.get('status'),dt,len(out[0]), err[:200]))
    if obj.get('status')=='ok':
        print('   cuts',obj['cuts'],'used',obj['used_bits'],'peak',obj['peak'])
# no-accel comparison for one case
fib = gen_fib(rng, 2048, 'long')
req={'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':sp.canon_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
     'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}
line=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))
out,dt,err = run([line], env={'SCAMP_NO_ACCEL':'1'})
print('pure-python compile 2048/16/32: %.2fs %s' % (dt, json.loads(out[0]).get('status')))
EOF
